push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.5 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
An 8.5, tuxedo_slide. You were the steady hand on the wheel tonight.

DID WELL
+ 14 passes (down from your usual 16). High involvement, high impact.
+ A brace against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway.
+ 1.0 above average. Growth looks good on you.
+ 2 shots on target: +0.1. Coach likes this one.
+ 8.5: top 25% among midfielders.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Simple fix: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- 57% passing (8 of 14). Easy win: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- No key passes from 14 passes. Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
- You and BellyTb1 can fix defensive work rate as a duo: pass runners off and track them into the box.

Pre-match routine: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso
